đa ta.source: A representation of information in a computer (as symbols, quantities, sound, images or videos) which is stored, processed or transmitted in the form of electrical signals, records on magnetic tape or punched cards, etc; Material recorded and known or assumed as facts and used as a basis for reasoning, discussion, or calculation, represented especially in the form of numbers, and usually structured (such as statistics)

đai.gloss: to malfunction; to crash; to be broken
đai.source: To stop living; to become dead; to undergo death; followed by of as an indication of direct cause; general use

đi-văng.gloss: a kind of long couch or sofa
đi-văng.source: any type of undistinguished couch; a divan in either of the original Turkish senses

đoan.source: customs an authority responsible for controlling the flow of goods to and from a country; customs office

đui.source: socket electrical socket; cartridge case (unprofessional; the correct term in the military is étui)

đô la.source: dollar, usually the US dollar; Canadian dollar

đề-pa.source: to divest, dispose of; to distribute
